name: Cubetcha 2023

venue.name: Mounds Park Academy

information:
This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdjlHIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e3a51fe70fb6f2dceb9ee0ae7c9b3093ea062019/image.png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation ](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing)for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

Mounds Park Academy is a PEANUT FREE school, and as such please do not bring food that contains peanuts to the competition.
